bullets.text: Armed conflict erupted in the Duskany region of Ostravia on September 3, 2025, when Karvale Front units opened artillery fire across the Varn River, striking the city of Varenholm.
An estimated 30,000 people fled Varenholm and surrounding villages in the first 36 hours, with 18,600 refugees registered across the border in Lumeria at Mirefeld.

A mediated humanitarian pause enabled the evacuation of around 4,200 civilians from the Weavers Quarter, and by day four the front line had stabilized along the Varn River with shelling sharply reduced.
Karvale Front artillery opens fire across the Varn River; explosions reported on the northern edge of Varenholm.
Residents were urged into shelters, with families using metro stations and basements during repeated air raid alerts.
The primary hazard was sustained cross-river artillery shelling of populated districts of Varenholm by Karvale Front forces.
Ostravia declared a state of emergency in the Duskany region within hours of the first strikes.
Air raid sirens sounded repeatedly across Varenholm from the first morning of the attack.
Residents expressed fear during the bombardment alongside solidarity, with accounts of neighbors sheltering together and sharing music in metro stations.
